item.title: Tourist Directional Sign - Graffiti Report, 6th October
item.description:
LOCATION Immediately south of the Hyde Lane / Southam Lane junction, near Webbs Garden Centre. ASSET Brown tourist directional sign for Ellenborough Park ROAD A435 Evesham Road. • Street View evidence indicates the defect has been present since at least September 2024. The graffiti substantially obscures the destination wording and tourism symbol, reducing the sign's effectiveness as a wayfinding asset. • The condition is highly visible on a principal approach to Ellenborough Park and presents a poor first impression for visitors.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Evesham Road, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury

item.title: Overhanging Crack Willow Tree next to 132 Abbotswood Road, GL3 4PF, 6th October
item.description:
I reported this problem over a year ago and it was judged not to be serious enough to warrant immediate action, but I was advised to report again if things got worse. A few months ago, a branch fell from the tree and struck one of my neighbours on the back of the head. We both took the matter up with the landowner but nothing has been done. With autumn approaching, I fear that more branches or the whole tree might come down as it is leaning even more heavily now than when first reported. Many children use this path on the way to and from school.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Abbotswood Road, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Massively Overgrown Hedgerow, 6th October
item.description:
The hedgerow and verge from Kennel Lane to St Georges Road are now very overgrown. It is no longer possible for cars to pass without damage to either vehicle. Either griding wheels on the kerb or scratching the paintwork from the coarse brambles growing out of the hedgerow and verge. The verge is no longer grass. It is all weeds and brambles. I would like to know who I contact to claim for damage to the paintwork on my car due to the lack of maintenance of the verge. It has not been properly cut back by tractor for at least five years.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Green Street, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
